short.lead: Six steps, each its own sub-issue of issue #389 (QA pages must prove each change with evidence for its type), built in this order. The first step turns the Ophan QA page's own content into a test that must be refused, so every later step is proven against the real failure. The design you approved (1A, 2A, 3A) is unchanged. Line counts are my estimates; the QA page will show the real counts from git beside them.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and what it needs from you.
items: The real failure becomes a test
Sub-issue #390 (the Ophan page's content becomes a test that must be refused). It fails on today's builder, which is the point.
The builder requires evidence by type
Sub-issue #391 (the page builder requires the evidence each change type needs): the evidence list, the type worked out from changed files (1A), and no way to skip it (3A).
Sub-issue #392 (the page template shows video clips, before and after side by side): two clips that play together (2A), and a 15 MB limit per clip.
Sub-issue #393 (the change list refuses a count of 0 changed files).
The handover reply needs a proven page
Sub-issue #394 (the handover reply counts only a QA page whose evidence passed).
Rules, docs, version and a real QA page
Sub-issue #395 (rule text, docs, version and a real QA page with clips). Then every issue moves to needs review and the QA page goes to you.
You run QA from the QA page.

changes: #390: the Ophan page's content becomes a test that must be refused
The case copies the content behind the Ophan QA page and expects the builder to refuse it. Today the builder builds it, so the case fails until #391 and #393 land.
The Ophan case and its fixture
#391: the page builder requires the evidence each change type needs
In QA mode, make_page.py checks each change against a new list of the evidence its type needs.
Pictures are checked only on Changes items marked visual, and only when the style file says pictures are required.
Every QA change carries evidence for its type, in every project. A type implied by the changed files can't be left out. A file path named in the text must be shown.

The default path patterns cover Unity: animator controllers and animation files mean animation, model files mean model, scripts under enemy or AI folders mean ai. A project adds its own patterns in page-style.json.
Evidence check, type detection and named-path check
#392: the page template shows video clips, before and after side by side
The page template gains support for video clips.
The page can show pictures only.
Clips as well, with before and after clips side by side that play and pause together.
The builder copies clips next to the page and refuses one over 15 MB. The QA page gets one card per evidence entry.
Clip and clip-pair markup, synced playback, evidence cards
#393: the change list refuses a count of 0 changed files
The build refuses a count of 0 and names the fix.
0 changed files prints "0 files, +0 −0" without complaint.
0 changed files refuses the build and says to build from the feature branch or set qa.base to the commit before the merge.
#394: the handover reply counts only a QA page whose evidence passed
The end-of-reply check for a QA page reads the record that make_page.py keeps of each page it built.
Any claude.ai artifact link in the reply satisfies the check.
Only the page make_page.py recorded with its evidence passed satisfies it.
qa page check reads the evidence record
#395: rule text, docs, version and a real QA page with clips
One rule line, two rule detail files, the docs, the plugin version, and a real run.
The rule asks for a before and after screenshot of a visual change.
The rule names the evidence each change type needs on a QA page and blocks the handover until it is attached.
The real run builds the QA page for #389 itself with the new builder.
